text:
Call `cmd.Flags()` to get the command’s complete `*flag.FlagSet`, including local and persistent flags declared on the command and its parents (`command.go:1641-1653`, `Command.Flags`).

For subsets, use `cmd.LocalFlags()` (`command.go:1669-1672`) or `cmd.InheritedFlags()` (`command.go:1695-1698`).
